brand.name: CineMate

hero.title: Distance shouldn't stop movie night.
hero.subtitle: Watch your favorite movies together, talk, chat and react — wherever you are.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Two flexible watch modes, instant connection, zero setup
howItWorks.step1Desc: Pick Dual Sync if both of you have the movie downloaded locally, or Screening Mode if only one person has the movie and streams it live.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Share your private room code or invite link with your partner. No sign-ups, accounts, or logins needed.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Watch together in real-time sync with built-in WebRTC voice chat, multi-track audio, and custom subtitles.
howItWorks.privacyNote: Your video stays on your device. We don't upload or store your video files.

features.title: Built for intimate cinema moments
features.dualModesDesc: Watch together your way: synchronize local movie files on both devices or let one person stream directly to their partner with 0 MB download.
features.syncDesc: Sub-20ms WebSocket sync keeps play, pause, seek, and speed changes aligned between both screens without lag.
features.voiceDesc: Talk naturally over WebRTC voice chat with live speaking visualizers, quick mute toggles, and floating emoji reactions.
features.privacyDesc: Your movies never upload to any server. Local files play directly in browser, or stream peer-to-peer over encrypted WebRTC.
features.audioSubsDesc: Switch language audio tracks (Tamil, English, etc.) and drop your own .SRT or .VTT subtitles directly into the player.
features.controlsDesc: Choose whether only the room host can pause and seek or give both viewers full control over playback.
